comparison: The random draw selected sound_nursery. I compared a dense panoramic nursery with many small response points against a close diagonal landing with a few large sails. The close landing makes the woman, her halted step and the nearest leaning organisms readable together, whereas the panorama weakens the encounter. The space-horror purpose and facial/hair reference are requester-grounded; all nursery organisms, hull anatomy, costume, pose, light and geometry are agent-owned and replaceable within open dimensions.
controls_application: Saved sensual=1 supports an intimate human presence through the warmly lit unguarded face and graceful arrested movement. Fetish=0 adds no fetish focus. Creativity=1 keeps later refinements close to this independently selected scene. Surreal=0 adds no separate surreal treatment beyond the fictional living ship and ecology chosen to realize the space-horror topic.
causal_readability: A single already-visible state links a halted raised boot and the nearby sails leaning toward it; far sails remain vertical. Pixels can establish these visible relations but cannot prove acoustic sensing, a prior sound, or a biological intention.
